articles.title: IIT-Bombay student dies by suicide after being caught using AI; students protest
articles.description: A second-year IIT-Bombay student died by suicide on Friday evening.  He had used an AI platform to seek answers during an examination.  Students gathered demanding a probe into mental health concerns and institutional actions.  The institute stated no disciplinary action was initiated against the student.  This incident follows another student suicide at the same hostel on July 28.

articles.title: Suicide blast at Pakistan police compound: Death toll mounts to 31
articles.description: The attack took place on Friday when an explosives-packed car was driven into the police facility as officers and their families were praying at a mosque inside the compound. Around 80 people, mostly police personnel, were taken to hospital after the blast. Several injured people were in critical condition, raising fears that the death toll could increase. The number of civilian casualties was not immediately known.

articles.description: Authorities are delving into the mysterious death of Yuvraj Singh Manchanda, reportedly murdered by former colleagues Anya Vats and Sanyam Sachdeva, who have both been taken into custody due to their prior criminal histories. Investigators are grappling with contradictory accounts surrounding the timeline of the body's disposal while exploring a potential monetary conflict, estimated between Rs 5 lakh and Rs 25 lakh, as a possible motive.

articles.title: Trump to meet Venezuela acting president, first meeting since Maduro’s removal
articles.description: President Donald Trump will meet acting Venezuelan President Delcy Rodriguez in New York. This meeting occurs during a reception for leaders attending the UN General Assembly. The leaders are expected to discuss Venezuela's energy sector and a recent oil reserves agreement. This engagement follows Washington's removal of former President Nicolas Maduro in January. Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado faces uncertainty regarding her return to the country.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Atlee yet again proves his love for Thalapathy Vijay at 'Baththa' event
articles.description: Filmmaker Atlee has expressed deep gratitude towards actor Vijay for his unwavering support throughout his career. This encouragement played a pivotal role in Atlee's choice to helm 'Jawan' featuring Shah Rukh Khan. He also credited Vijay Sethupathi for his integral role in the creation of 'Baththa.' Atlee is optimistic about the future of young composer Sai Abhyankkar and believes that 'Baththa' conveys a universal message that resonates across various generations.

articles.title: Nick Reiner has still not been able to access his trust fund while in custody
articles.description: Nick Reiner is currently in custody, facing serious murder charges while awaiting trial. His significant trust fund, intended for legal defense, is out of reach due to the Slayer Statute implications. His legal team is seeking court permission to utilize these funds for his commissary and defense costs, especially since he has not received any money for essential jail necessities.

articles.description: Actor Vijayaraghavan shared his childhood experiences with theatre's social stigma. His family faced societal disapproval for their involvement in acting. articles.title: 'I would like to thank my mother, my father...': Jason Sanjay
articles.description: At the launch event for the Sigma trailer and audio, filmmaker Jason Sanjay conveyed heartfelt thanks to his family, particularly recognizing the support of his father, the Chief Minister, and his mother. He also expressed appreciation for industry stalwarts like SS Rajamouli and Dulquer Salmaan. Sanjay commended the film’s leading stars, Sundeep Kishan and Faria Abdullah, ahead of Sigma's release on October 2.
